messages:
mira (product): quick sync — proposing a trimmed roadmap for traffic policies + tenancy boundaries. need to lock scope for the next planning cycle.

josh (eng): sounds good. is this focused on control-plane policy language or data-plane routing logic?

mira (product): both, but we should split deliverables. control-plane: policy DSL + UI for rules. data-plane: runtime routing, multi-region failover, tenant isolation. prioritize minimal viable policies first.

leah (infra): +1 to split. for MVP we should support: region affinity, cost-tier routing, and emergency fallback to shared GPU pools. anything beyond that inflates infra work.

daniel (arch): agree. we also need clear isolation tiers: "soft-tenant" (logical teams, shared kernels), "hard-tenant" (dedicated pools, no cross-tenant cache), and "gov-tenant" (Private with audited KMS). each has different SLO/cost targets.

mira (product): exactly — launch criteria proposal: 1) policy DSL v0 (JSON/YAML) covers region + tier + model fallback, 2) routing infra supports cross-region routing with <150ms added latency for warm cache, 3) isolation tier enforcement tested for cache/KV boundaries.

josh (eng): quick note: cross-region routing will need request affinity + KV cache consistency strategy. if we route to a different region, we must either warm KV or fallback to cold-start path. that impacts latency SLOs.

leah (infra): on that, we can implement prefix-aware cache keys and async prefetch for hot prefixes. but prefetch needs traffic signals — we'll need sampling endpoints. also impacts egress costs.

mira (product): tradeoffs to call out in PRD: latency vs cost, and complexity vs configurability for customers. we should default to conservative policies for Self-Serve and allow enterprise to opt into aggressive cross-region.

daniel (arch): proposal for rollout stages: Stage 0: policy read-only + simulation mode. Stage 1: enforced routing in canary regions + observability. Stage 2: global rollout + isolation enforcement. Each stage requires specific test suites (chaos, perf, tenant leakage).

josh (eng): +1. add automated regression tests that run against Dedicated & Private images. Also need hooks in the Console to show per-route token/cost impact.

mira (product): customer asks: two enterprise customers asked for geo-fencing + per-tenant rollback. we need to include rollback playbook and per-tenant fallback to previous model version.

leah (infra): rollback playbook sounds straightforward if control-plane can pin routes to model versions. ensure control-plane changes are versioned and auditable.

sre-bot: incident note — last cross-region test showed 12% higher tail latency during bursts; filing ticket INF-4827 for aker.

daniel (arch): good catch. add perf budget: p95 increase <= 20ms on cross-region failover, p99 <= 100ms. If exceeded, automatic fallback to local model variant.

mira (product): timeline ask: can we aim for Stage 0 + Stage 1 in Q3, Stage 2 in Q4?

josh (eng): Q3 for sim+canary seems tight but possible if we limit initial policy DSL surface (region, tier, fallback). Q4 for global rollout contingent on infra capacity and Dedicated compatibility testing.

leah (infra): resource note: need 2 FTEs + 1 infra sprint to build async prefetch and routing signals. also require cost estimate for cross-region egress.

mira (product): ok — action items: 1) josh + daniel write short RFC for policy DSL v0 by end of week, 2) leah to scope infra spike for cache prefetch & egress numbers, 3) product to draft launch criteria and customer playbook.

josh (eng): I'll start the RFC. leaning toward simple YAML with matchers and a fallback chain. example: ```policies:
 - name: low-latency
   match: region: us-west
   route: local
   fallback: regional
 - name: cost-save
   match: customers: ["startup"]
   route: shared
   fallback: queued```

mira (product): perfect. let's sync Tuesday 10am to approve scope. tagging @everyone. :thumbsup:

daniel (arch): adding note to RFC: must include telemetry contract (per-request route decision, reason, and cache-state).

leah (infra): will add cost and infra acceptance criteria to the infra spike doc.

sre-bot: deploy schedule reminder — infra spike can occupy staging capacity next Wed.

mira (product): thanks all. meeting invite incoming.
